parsed_json.up: Select IC50 activity records for the human single-protein target Amine oxidase [flavin-containing] A identified by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1951. Return columns: compound_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), canonical_smiles (from compound_structures), compound_key (from compound_records), pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer docs.pubmed_id, fall back to docs.doi), assay_description (from assays.description), standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id (from target_dictionary.chembl_id), target_name (from target_dictionary.pref_name), target_organism (from target_dictionary.organism). Join path: target_dictionary (tid) -> assays (tid) -> activities (assay_id) -> compound_records (record_id) -> molecule_dictionary (molregno) -> compound_structures (molregno, INNER JOIN), and activities.doc_id -> docs. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1951', activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Exclude rows where canonical_smiles is null or pubmed_id_or_doi is null. Keep all qualifying activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
